task: Independent review of completed pilot scientific representation, before generalizing to full catalogue/poster outputs.

scope.paper_support_limit: Paper evidence was inspected in archived extraction/review quotations. Original full source packets are remote and were not fully replayed locally. No claim of full-paper independent verification.

contract.State: A material or data boundary with source-supported consequential features; it is not an operation.
contract.Operation: A local transformation or inspection instance with explicit State inputs and outputs, at schematic granularity.
contract.Flow: A typed incident input/output or ordering connection. A chain of incident Flows alone does not prove per-molecule or per-input/output attribution.
contract.success: Preserve depicted transformations, separate retained branches, supported readout identity and scoped applicability without adding unshown execution details.
contract.not_identified: Experimental execution equivalence, causal ancestry, molecular recovery completeness and independent branch routing are not established by common names or generic graph reachability.

findings.observation: One Operation combines the two separately amplified branches as two inputs and two outputs. Its information_effect correctly disclaims physical mixing, but the incident graph does not encode the input/output pairing.

source_support.locator: Upper Smart-seq2 amplification branch and lower MDA amplification branch have separate rightward arrows under the shared Sequence caption; same-cell data are subsequently aligned.
source_support.independent_inspection: Original reacquired bytes match the archived source hash. Transparent original and white-background rendition inspected.

findings.deterministic_reproduction: probe_result.json records a depth-two incidence route from s_transcriptome_product through o_sequence to s_dna_reads, and the converse cross-branch route.
findings.host_detection: Not detected: current DiagramExtraction graph checks accept all endpoints, I/O agreement and DAG topology. They do not infer the scientific meaning of joint versus independent processing.
findings.fresh_archived_review_detection: Not detected: operation:o_sequence was accepted with the rationale that the shared operation record does not imply material pooling. This addresses prose but leaves structural branch attribution ambiguous.
findings.why_it_matters: An agent using reachability as molecular lineage or as proof of which branch produces a readout could make a wrong attribution. The artifact does not literally assert an RNA-to-genomic-DNA conversion, so this is not classified as a chemistry hallucination.
findings.minimal_remedy: Future extraction/review prompts must treat an Operation as an instance: independent repeated processing under a shared caption gets distinct branch-specific Operation instances; source-supported true joins/splits stay joint. Query results must describe incidence and surface unresolved pairing rather than claim molecular lineage.
findings.deployment_boundary: Preserve pilot and frozen main/poster outputs. Repair G&T in a new version and audit completed multi-input/multi-output Operations for the same general ambiguity.

general_limits: An exact source quote and a matching source ID establish traceability, not entailment of every feature, mechanism or information-effect statement.
Typed material/data endpoints cannot by themselves enforce molecular species identity or barcode/compartment conservation expressed in natural language.
Fresh reviewer sessions reduce direct conversational dependence but do not guarantee independent error modes; F01 survived a fresh review.
One observed failure in two pilot records is not a catalogue-wide error-rate estimate. Completed main/poster multi-input/output cases still require audit.

No new experimental infeasibility or unsupported chemistry was confirmed from the two inspected source diagrams and archived evidence. This is bounded evidence, not a guarantee that the records are error-free.

prompt_proposal.shared: An Operation is a local transformation or inspection instance, not a reusable label. When independent retained branches are processed separately under one shared or repeated caption, record distinct Operation instances with branch-specific inputs and outputs, retaining that source caption on each. A common caption does not establish pooling or a joint transformation. Keep genuine mixing, splitting and data-integration operations multi-input/output when supported; do not automatically split every such operation.
prompt_proposal.reviewer: For every multi-input/multi-output Operation, check whether it denotes one joint operation or separate processing compressed under a shared caption. Follow each branch through its correct output. If the candidate collapses independent branch operations, request revision even when prose says the fractions remain separate. Do not infer input-to-output molecular attribution solely from graph reachability.
